tasks.title: Project scaffolding: FormcheckCore SPM package + Formcheck (iOS/Catalyst) and FormcheckWatch Xcode targets
acceptance_criteria: xcodebuild -list shows Formcheck (iOS+Catalyst) and FormcheckWatch schemes
Empty app launches in iOS Simulator to a blank root view with no crash
FormcheckCore package resolves as a local dependency of both targets

tasks.title: Core models & enums: WorkoutSession, ExerciseKind, SessionStatus, HealthKitWriteStatus, FormFlagRecord, Joint/JointFrame, CapabilityGap, WatchRepUpdate, WatchSessionSnapshot, RuleEngineEvent
acceptance_criteria: Package builds with zero third-party dependencies
Unit test proves WorkoutSession.finalize-time validation rejects a squat session carrying holdDuration or a plank session carrying repCount

tasks.title: RepStateMachine + Squat/PushUp/Plank rule engines
acceptance_criteria: Fixture-driven unit tests independently validate squat (160/100 knee angle), push-up (160/90 elbow angle), and plank (180±15 hip angle, 1s sustained) — no shared test asserts all three from one fixture
A rep that never reaches depth still counts but its FormFlagRecord.message names the actual measured and threshold degrees, verified in a test asserting on the string content
Plank test asserts a directional sagging vs. piking flag

tasks.title: HeuristicExerciseClassifier with in-app disclosure string
acceptance_criteria: Unit test proves classify() distinguishes squat/push-up/plank fixture sequences via torso-orientation + joint-cyclicity variance
methodDescription is a non-empty string documenting the heuristic, asserted equal to the literal copy later surfaced in onboarding/Settings

tasks.title: SessionRepository (ModelActor), isDemo query filter, demo fixture data
acceptance_criteria: In-memory ModelContainer tests cover startSession/persistIncrementalProgress/appendFormFlag/markFinalizing/finalize
A simulated low-disk-space clip write failure leaves the session saved with repCount/duration/flags intact and clipRelativePath nil

SessionQuerying.predicate(includeDemo: false, ...) is the single filter reused by History, Charts, HealthKit eligibility, and export in later tasks — proven by one shared test helper, not per-screen logic

tasks.title: SessionReconciliationService + KnownLimitsStore (pre-seeded HealthKit gap)
acceptance_criteria: Unit test seeds one .inProgress and one .finalizing orphaned session in-memory, runs reconcileOrphanedSessions, both resolve to .completedEndedEarly with their captured data intact
KnownLimitsStore contains exactly one HealthKit-entitlement-presumed-blocked CapabilityGap immediately after init, before any user action

tasks.title: PoseObservationAdapter (multi-person selection) + VisionPoseProcessor
acceptance_criteria: Unit test over an injectable bounding-box/confidence seam proves selectPrimaryObservation picks the largest-area observation, tie-broken by average joint confidence
Code review confirms alwaysDiscardsLateVideoFrames = true is set and no frame backlog is queued

tasks.title: CameraCapabilityDetecting (ready/noHardware/denied/restricted)
acceptance_criteria: Unit test with an injectable AVCaptureDevice-status seam proves all four states map correctly
Simulator run confirms .noHardware is the real, observed result (not asserted only)

tasks.title: Concrete WCSession-backed WatchRelay + FakeWatchRelay test double
acceptance_criteria: Unit test drives per-rep send logic against a FakeWatchRelay reporting isPaired/isWatchAppInstalled/isReachable = false and asserts no crash and no uncaught throw
A second test with isReachable = true asserts sendRepUpdate is called once per counted rep
sendMessage call sites all pass a required error handler; updateApplicationContext used for last-known-state snapshot

tasks.title: HealthKitWriting (write-only, type+duration only, entitlement-unavailable path)
acceptance_criteria: Unit test with an injectable HKHealthStore-status seam covers notDetermined/authorized/denied/unavailableEntitlement
A denied or unavailable write never throws and never blocks or mutates the already-saved local session

tasks.title: SessionExportService/SessionImportService + bundle archive including clip video bytes
acceptance_criteria: Unit test exports a session with a fixture clip into a bundle, imports it into a fresh in-memory store, and asserts both metadata and playable video bytes round-trip
Demo sessions are excluded from export unless includeDemo is explicitly passed

tasks.title: Theme.swift design tokens
acceptance_criteria: Compiles standalone; SwiftUI preview exercises every color role in light and dark
amberStroke and amberText are distinct hex values, each documented against its WCAG contrast threshold (3:1 graphical / 4.5:1 text)
RepHero counter has an explicit non-default Dynamic Type rule (large base size, minimumScaleFactor, vertically-growing container)

tasks.title: HomeView five-state flow
acceptance_criteria: Simulator run (no camera hardware) shows the noHardware capability-blocked state with its own icon and remedy text on first launch, not a generic error banner
Empty/first-run state shown distinctly when no sessions exist and demo is off

tasks.title: CaptureSessionModel + CaptureRootView (silhouette guide, RepHero counter, classifier chip, amber annotation, finalizing state)
acceptance_criteria: Demo-session toggle run in Simulator produces a real counted rep sequence and at least one specific, rule-named form flag with amber annotation naming measured/threshold degrees
Tapping the classifier chip overrides the active exercise for the remainder of the set
Capture modal performs its own independent capability check on appear rather than trusting Home's precomputed state
sessionStatus is set to .finalizing synchronously the instant End is tapped, before the async write completes

tasks.title: PostSetSummarySheet
acceptance_criteria: Ending a demo set presents a .large-detent sheet reusing SessionDetailView content, showing final count/hold-duration and the fired flag if any, with a single Done action routing to History

tasks.title: HistoryView (list/calendar, demo fencing)
acceptance_criteria: A completed demo session appears in History within the same app run (validates cross-context @Query visibility from the background ModelActor write)
Demo rows carry a persistent dashed border plus badge distinct from real sessions

tasks.title: SessionDetailView (+ Catalyst clip scrubber/skeleton overlay) and ExerciseTrendChart
acceptance_criteria: ExerciseTrendChart excludes demo sessions from aggregation via SessionQuerying and shows a 'demo sessions excluded' disclosure when any exist
Catalyst destination build shows CatalystClipScrubber + SkeletonOverlayToggle gated by #if targetEnvironment(macCatalyst); iOS build never compiles or shows them

tasks.title: SettingsView + KnownLimitsView
acceptance_criteria: Classifier methodDescription is discoverable within two taps from Settings
HealthKit permission status is shown live with a re-request path
Exercise enable/disable toggles hide disabled exercises from Home's start-set options
Any should-have feature not finished by build end routes its Settings row to a dated KnownLimitsView entry instead of showing a live-looking but non-functional control

tasks.title: CatalystBrowserView + import entry point
acceptance_criteria: On the Mac Catalyst destination, importing an exported archive populates a NavigationSplitView sidebar with a real, openable session for frame-by-frame skeleton review
This view renders no camera/capture UI anywhere

tasks.title: FormcheckWatch UI (idle + in-session) and watch-side session controller
acceptance_criteria: Simulator run of the Watch target alone (unpaired) shows an honest 'iPhone unreachable' idle glance, never a spinner
Unit test on the watch-side controller confirms a haptic trigger call fires once per received WatchRepUpdate

tasks.title: AccessibilityAnnouncer wired into capture flow
acceptance_criteria: Manual VoiceOver-on Simulator run confirms an AccessibilityNotification.Announcement fires on every counted rep and every fired form flag during a demo session
Reduce Motion preserves the amber annotation's full informational hold duration while dropping only the trace-in animation

tasks.title: InterruptionCoordinator (AVCaptureSession interruptions -> ended-early)
acceptance_criteria: Unit/integration test posts a synthetic AVCaptureSession.wasInterruptedNotification mid-capture and asserts the session finalizes as completedEndedEarly through the same path used for backgrounding, not a separate handler

tasks.title: Full local data export/erase (deletes on-disk clip files, not just rows)
acceptance_criteria: Unit test creates sessions with on-disk clip files, runs erase, and asserts both the SwiftData rows and the actual clip files are removed from the backup-excluded container

tasks.title: StoreKit 2 Pro entitlement (offline-cached, downstream-only gating)
acceptance_criteria: A Simulator .storekit-config test purchases, refunds, and fast-forwards a renewal, asserting entitlement remains valid offline and is never re-validated mid-session
No rule-engine or classifier code path reads entitlement state

tasks.title: Share-sheet summary card renderer (clip-free by construction)
acceptance_criteria: ShareCardRenderer's input type only accepts rep count/duration/flag text/chart image — no clip URL or camera-frame type is representable in its signature
Manual share-sheet run confirms the rendered output contains no video thumbnail or camera frame

tasks.title: Per-requirement verification-method tagging (Simulator-observed / code-only / requires-real-hardware)
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement id from requirements.json has exactly one verification-method tag, cross-checked against what was actually run and observed in Simulator this build versus what is code-only or hardware-only
